  • 📉 Point Cost Range: Leman Russ tanks cost between 145 and 235 points, impacting army composition and strategy.
  • 🔢 Weapon Stats: The standard battle cannon deals damage of D6+3 shots with a range of 48 inches, while the Demolisher cannon can do D6+1 shots at 24 inches.
